text:
Maya: pet photo drop! Meet Mochi, my senior fluff bun. He inexplicably prefers socks over actual hay. pic: https://i.imgur.com/mochi1.jpg :rabbit:
Dan: socks??? that's peak rabbit energy. also that stare is deeply judgmental in the best way :joy:
Ivy: Mochi 4 office therapist. can confirm socks = happiness. pic of my cat doing his loaf impression: https://i.imgur.com/loafcat.jpg :heart_eyes:
Ben: HRBot FYI: bringing pets to HQ still needs the short form filled out, right?
HRBot: reminder: please submit the Pet-Onsite Waiver at https://hr.internal/forms/pet-waiver by Monday 9AM. Also tag allergies in the form.
Maya: noted! Mochi is hypoallergenic (according to our neighbor) and will STARE at your lunch politely
Dan: caption contest time: "When you hear 'walk' but it was just the mailman"
Ivy: "I have seen things" is my vote
Ben: "Plotting the great sock heist" runner-up
Maya: loving these. also small ask 0— if anyone brings snacks please avoid nuts; allergic folks in office. filling waiver now :pencil2:
Dan: bringing chewy carrot treats for Mochi and a tiny carrot hat for style reasons :carrot:
Ivy: will bring a tiny doily for the loaf to rest on, aesthetics matter
Ben: someone make a Slack emoji for Mochi pls :paw_prints:
Maya: yes!! thank you all. Mochi will be briefed on corporate etiquette (aka napping in meeting rooms only if invited)
